    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_APPLY.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"局部接口：",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_UNIT_KEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_LANGUAGE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_EXPECTED_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_REQUEST) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_SYSTEM) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CLIENT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_USER) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_COMMITTED) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_BEFORE_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TEXT_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TABKEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGID) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGNO) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ES_TEXT) TYPE  T006A",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "\" 此 RFC 自己拥有 LUW；仅限现有 T006A 描述，不创建单位或语言行。",
    "DATA: lv_unit TYPE t006a-msehi,",
    "      lv_language TYPE t006a-spras,",
    "      lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname,",
    "      lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,",
    "      lv_request TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_task TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_policy TYPE t000-cccoractiv,",
    "      ls_parent TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_header TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_checked_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      ls_checked_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071,",
    "      lt_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071k,",
    "      lv_not_lockable TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      lv_locktype TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      ls_before TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_after TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_readback TYPE t006a,",
    "      lt_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006a,",
    "      lv_read_code TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_system TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_client TYPE string,",
    "      lv_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_after_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_unit_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_request_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_task_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_commit_started TYPE c,",
    "      lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,",
    "      lv_matches TYPE i,",
    "      lv_hash_data TYPE string,",
    "      lv_algorithm TYPE hashalg VALUE 'SHA2'.",
    "CLEAR: ev_code, ev_system, ev_client, ev_user, ev_committed,",
    "       ev_before_version,",
    "       ev_text_version, ev_task, ev_tabkey, ev_msgid, ev_msgno, es_text.",
    "ev_system = sy-sysid.",
    "ev_client = sy-mandt.",
    "ev_user = sy-uname.",
    "IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",
    "  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF strlen( iv_unit_key ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_unit_key ) > 3",
    "OR strlen( iv_language ) <> 1 OR strlen( iv_expected_version ) <> 64",
    "OR iv_expected_version CN '0123456789abcdef'",
    "OR strlen( iv_request ) <> 10 OR strlen( iv_task ) <> 10",
    "OR iv_request = iv_task.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^[A-Za-z0-9]$' IN iv_language.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_request.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_task.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit = iv_unit_key.",
    "lv_language = iv_language.",
    "lv_request = iv_request.",
    "lv_task = iv_task.",
    "IF iv_unit_key(1) = space OR strlen( lv_unit ) <> strlen( iv_unit_key )",
    "OR iv_unit_key CA '*|'.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_unit_key.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht <> space AND iv_set_mseht <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl <> space AND iv_set_msehl <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_set_msehl = space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_mseht <> space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = space AND iv_msehl <> space ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "\" 空值清除仍需独立业务验收，本版仅允许非空描述。",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_mseht ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_mseht ) > 10",
    "       OR iv_mseht CO space OR iv_mseht CP ' *' ) )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_msehl ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_msehl ) > 30",
    "       OR iv_msehl CO space OR iv_msehl CP ' *' ) ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_mseht.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_msehl.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "DO 2 TIMES.",
    "  IF sy-index = 1.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006A'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR lv_group.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat",
    "    WHERE tabname = lv_table.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.",
    "    lv_group = '&NC&'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '02' ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD lv_group.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDDO.",
    "\" E_TABLE 的初始 VARKEY 在已读生成函数中变为 *，覆盖 CUNI 的维度锁。",
    "\" 不等待；该全表锁会短暂阻止其他客户端/单位的 CUNI 维护。",
    "CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TABLE'",
    "  EXPORTING tabname = 'T006' varkey = space _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "  EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'UNIT_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "  ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit_locked = 'X'.",
    "TRY.",
    "  DO 1 TIMES.",
    "    \" 仅锁指定父请求和任务；TRINT_LOCK_REQUEST 自带 COMMIT，不能复用。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_request _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_request_locked = 'X'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_task _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_task_locked = 'X'.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE cccoractiv INTO lv_policy FROM t000 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_policy NA '01'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CLIENT_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" ALE_EDIT_CHECK_2 含无条件 MESSAGE I；有 CUNI 分布式规则就拒绝。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd72 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE objekttyp = 'T' AND objektname = 'CUNI'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 标准模型读取会缓存/过滤规则；本版拒绝所有 CONDAT 记录，保守限缩范围。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd05 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mestyp = 'CONDAT'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_parent-trkorr = lv_request.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_parent",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_parent-trfunction <> 'W'",
    "    OR ls_parent-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_parent-strkorr <> space",
    "    OR ls_parent-client <> sy-mandt OR ls_parent-tarsystem = space.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_header-trkorr = lv_task.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_header",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_header-trfunction <> 'Q'",
    "    OR ls_header-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_header-strkorr <> lv_request",
    "    OR ls_header-as4user <> sy-uname OR ls_header-client <> sy-mandt.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 锁内调用同一个只读 API，版本包含键、别名和两个描述的完整行。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_READ'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_unit_key = iv_unit_key iv_language = iv_language",
    "      IMPORTING ev_code = lv_read_code ev_system = lv_read_system",
    "        ev_client = lv_read_client ev_text_version = lv_version",
    "        es_text = ls_before",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_read_code <> 'READ'",
    "    OR lv_read_system <> 'GR2' OR lv_read_client <> '200'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'READ_PRECONDITION_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF lv_version <> iv_expected_version.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 表缓冲读不作为锁内新鲜度证据，必须与数据库完整行一致。",
    "    SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_readback",
    "      FROM t006a BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_readback <> ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_after = ls_before.",
    "    IF iv_set_mseht = 'X'. ls_after-mseht = iv_mseht. ENDIF.",
    "    IF iv_set_msehl = 'X'. ls_after-msehl = iv_msehl. ENDIF.",
    "    IF ls_after = ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'NO_CHANGES'.",
    "      ev_before_version = lv_version.",
    "      ev_text_version = lv_version.",
    "      es_text = ls_before.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_object-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_object-object = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_object-obj_name = 'CUNI'.",
    "    ls_object-objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_OBJECT'",
    "      EXPORTING is_object = ls_object is_request_header = ls_header",
    "        iv_check_lockability = 'X' iv_dialog = space",
    "        iv_release_checks = space",
    "      IMPORTING es_object = ls_checked_object",
    "        ev_object_not_lockable = lv_not_lockable",
    "        ev_locktype = lv_locktype",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_OBJECT_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 拒绝需要版本管理/TLOCK/修复分支的对象，保持本版单一 DB LUW。",
    "    IF lv_not_lockable <> 'X' OR lv_locktype <> space",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-pgmid <> 'R3TR'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-object <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-obj_name <> 'CUNI'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-objfunc <> 'K'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCKABLE_OBJECT_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_key-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_key-object = 'TABU'.",
    "    ls_key-objname = 'T006A'.",
    "    ls_key-mastertype = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_key-mastername = 'CUNI'.",
    "    CONCATENATE ls_before-mandt ls_before-spras ls_before-msehi",
    "      INTO ls_key-tabkey RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_KEY'",
    "      EXPORTING is_key = ls_key is_request_header = ls_header",
    "      IMPORTING es_key = ls_checked_key",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_checked_key-tabkey <> ls_key-tabkey",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-pgmid <> 'R3TR' OR ls_checked_key-object <> 'TABU'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-objname <> 'T006A'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastertype <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastername <> 'CUNI'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_KEY_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    APPEND ls_object TO lt_objects.",
    "    APPEND ls_key TO lt_keys.",
    "    \" 继续运行标准所有权/对象/语言键校验，所有跳过检查标志均保持默认。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_APPEND_TO_COMM_ARRAYS'",
    "      EXPORTING wi_trkorr = lv_task iv_dialog = space",
    "      TABLES wt_e071 = lt_objects wt_e071k = lt_keys",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_APPEND_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND obj_name = 'CUNI' AND objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071k",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TABU'",
    "        AND objname = 'T006A' AND mastertype = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND mastername = 'CUNI'",
    "        AND tabkey = ls_key-tabkey.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 同步调用标准 UPDATE_T006A，避免 CTS 先提交而 V1 更新后失败。",
    "    APPEND ls_after TO lt_text.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'UPDATE_T006A'",
    "      TABLES t006a_tab = lt_text",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_UPDATE_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    CLEAR ls_readback.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_readback",
    "      FROM t006a BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_readback <> ls_after.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_READBACK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 仍在 SAP 中按只读 API 的固定宽度 v1 格式计算真实数据库行版本。",
    "    CONCATENATE 'T006A:v1:' sy-sysid ls_readback-mandt ls_readback-spras",
    "      ls_readback-msehi ls_readback-mseh3 ls_readback-mseh6",
    "      ls_readback-mseht ls_readback-msehl",
    "      INTO lv_hash_data RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_CHAR'",
    "      EXPORTING alg = lv_algorithm data = lv_hash_data",

    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_APPLY.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"局部接口：",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_UNIT_KEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_LANGUAGE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_EXPECTED_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_REQUEST) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_SYSTEM) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CLIENT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_USER) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_COMMITTED) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_BEFORE_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TEXT_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TABKEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGID) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGNO) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ES_TEXT) TYPE  T006A",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "\" 此 RFC 自己拥有 LUW；仅限现有 T006A 描述，不创建单位或语言行。",
    "DATA: lv_unit TYPE t006a-msehi,",
    "      lv_language TYPE t006a-spras,",
    "      lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname,",
    "      lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,",
    "      lv_request TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_task TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_policy TYPE t000-cccoractiv,",
    "      ls_parent TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_header TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_checked_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      ls_checked_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071,",
    "      lt_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071k,",
    "      lv_not_lockable TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      lv_locktype TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      ls_before TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_after TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_readback TYPE t006a,",
    "      lt_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006a,",
    "      lv_read_code TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_system TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_client TYPE string,",
    "      lv_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_after_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_unit_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_request_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_task_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_commit_started TYPE c,",
    "      lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,",
    "      lv_matches TYPE i,",
    "      lv_hash_data TYPE string,",
    "      lv_algorithm TYPE hashalg VALUE 'SHA2'.",
    "CLEAR: ev_code, ev_system, ev_client, ev_user, ev_committed,",
    "       ev_before_version,",
    "       ev_text_version, ev_task, ev_tabkey, ev_msgid, ev_msgno, es_text.",
    "ev_system = sy-sysid.",
    "ev_client = sy-mandt.",
    "ev_user = sy-uname.",
    "IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",
    "  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF strlen( iv_unit_key ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_unit_key ) > 3",
    "OR strlen( iv_language ) <> 1 OR strlen( iv_expected_version ) <> 64",
    "OR iv_expected_version CN '0123456789abcdef'",
    "OR strlen( iv_request ) <> 10 OR strlen( iv_task ) <> 10",
    "OR iv_request = iv_task.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^[A-Za-z0-9]$' IN iv_language.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_request.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_task.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit = iv_unit_key.",
    "lv_language = iv_language.",
    "lv_request = iv_request.",
    "lv_task = iv_task.",
    "IF iv_unit_key(1) = space OR strlen( lv_unit ) <> strlen( iv_unit_key )",
    "OR iv_unit_key CA '*|'.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_unit_key.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht <> space AND iv_set_mseht <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl <> space AND iv_set_msehl <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_set_msehl = space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_mseht <> space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = space AND iv_msehl <> space ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "\" 空值清除仍需独立业务验收，本版仅允许非空描述。",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_mseht ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_mseht ) > 10",
    "       OR iv_mseht CO space OR iv_mseht CP ' *' ) )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_msehl ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_msehl ) > 30",
    "       OR iv_msehl CO space OR iv_msehl CP ' *' ) ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_mseht.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_msehl.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "DO 2 TIMES.",
    "  IF sy-index = 1.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006A'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR lv_group.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat",
    "    WHERE tabname = lv_table.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.",
    "    lv_group = '&NC&'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '02' ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD lv_group.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDDO.",
    "\" E_TABLE 的初始 VARKEY 在已读生成函数中变为 *，覆盖 CUNI 的维度锁。",
    "\" 不等待；该全表锁会短暂阻止其他客户端/单位的 CUNI 维护。",
    "CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TABLE'",
    "  EXPORTING tabname = 'T006' varkey = space _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "  EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'UNIT_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "  ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit_locked = 'X'.",
    "TRY.",
    "  DO 1 TIMES.",
    "    \" 仅锁指定父请求和任务；TRINT_LOCK_REQUEST 自带 COMMIT，不能复用。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_request _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_request_locked = 'X'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_task _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_task_locked = 'X'.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE cccoractiv INTO lv_policy FROM t000 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_policy NA '01'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CLIENT_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" ALE_EDIT_CHECK_2 含无条件 MESSAGE I；有 CUNI 分布式规则就拒绝。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd72 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE objekttyp = 'T' AND objektname = 'CUNI'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 标准模型读取会缓存/过滤规则；本版拒绝所有 CONDAT 记录，保守限缩范围。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd05 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mestyp = 'CONDAT'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_parent-trkorr = lv_request.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_parent",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_parent-trfunction <> 'W'",
    "    OR ls_parent-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_parent-strkorr <> space",
    "    OR ls_parent-client <> sy-mandt OR ls_parent-tarsystem = space.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_header-trkorr = lv_task.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_header",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_header-trfunction <> 'Q'",
    "    OR ls_header-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_header-strkorr <> lv_request",
    "    OR ls_header-as4user <> sy-uname OR ls_header-client <> sy-mandt.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 锁内调用同一个只读 API，版本包含键、别名和两个描述的完整行。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_READ'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_unit_key = iv_unit_key iv_language = iv_language",
    "      IMPORTING ev_code = lv_read_code ev_system = lv_read_system",
    "        ev_client = lv_read_client ev_text_version = lv_version",
    "        es_text = ls_before",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_read_code <> 'READ'",
    "    OR lv_read_system <> 'GR2' OR lv_read_client <> '200'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'READ_PRECONDITION_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF lv_version <> iv_expected_version.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 表缓冲读不作为锁内新鲜度证据，必须与数据库完整行一致。",
    "    SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_readback",
    "      FROM t006a BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_readback <> ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_after = ls_before.",
    "    IF iv_set_mseht = 'X'. ls_after-mseht = iv_mseht. ENDIF.",
    "    IF iv_set_msehl = 'X'. ls_after-msehl = iv_msehl. ENDIF.",
    "    IF ls_after = ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'NO_CHANGES'.",
    "      ev_before_version = lv_version.",
    "      ev_text_version = lv_version.",
    "      es_text = ls_before.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_object-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_object-object = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_object-obj_name = 'CUNI'.",
    "    ls_object-objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_OBJECT'",
    "      EXPORTING is_object = ls_object is_request_header = ls_header",
    "        iv_check_lockability = 'X' iv_dialog = space",
    "        iv_release_checks = space",
    "      IMPORTING es_object = ls_checked_object",
    "        ev_object_not_lockable = lv_not_lockable",
    "        ev_locktype = lv_locktype",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_OBJECT_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 拒绝需要版本管理/TLOCK/修复分支的对象，保持本版单一 DB LUW。",
    "    IF lv_not_lockable <> 'X' OR lv_locktype <> space",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-pgmid <> 'R3TR'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-object <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-obj_name <> 'CUNI'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-objfunc <> 'K'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCKABLE_OBJECT_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_key-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_key-object = 'TABU'.",
    "    ls_key-objname = 'T006A'.",
    "    ls_key-mastertype = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_key-mastername = 'CUNI'.",
    "    CONCATENATE ls_before-mandt ls_before-spras ls_before-msehi",
    "      INTO ls_key-tabkey RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_KEY'",
    "      EXPORTING is_key = ls_key is_request_header = ls_header",
    "      IMPORTING es_key = ls_checked_key",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_checked_key-tabkey <> ls_key-tabkey",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-pgmid <> 'R3TR' OR ls_checked_key-object <> 'TABU'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-objname <> 'T006A'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastertype <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastername <> 'CUNI'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_KEY_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    APPEND ls_object TO lt_objects.",
    "    APPEND ls_key TO lt_keys.",
    "    \" 继续运行标准所有权/对象/语言键校验，所有跳过检查标志均保持默认。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_APPEND_TO_COMM_ARRAYS'",
    "      EXPORTING wi_trkorr = lv_task iv_dialog = space",
    "      TABLES wt_e071 = lt_objects wt_e071k = lt_keys",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_APPEND_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND obj_name = 'CUNI' AND objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071k",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TABU'",
    "        AND objname = 'T006A' AND mastertype = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND mastername = 'CUNI'",
    "        AND tabkey = ls_key-tabkey.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 同步调用标准 UPDATE_T006A，避免 CTS 先提交而 V1 更新后失败。",
    "    APPEND ls_after TO lt_text.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'UPDATE_T006A'",
    "      TABLES t006a_tab = lt_text",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_UPDATE_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    CLEAR ls_readback.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_readback",
    "      FROM t006a BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_readback <> ls_after.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_READBACK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 仍在 SAP 中按只读 API 的固定宽度 v1 格式计算真实数据库行版本。",
    "    CONCATENATE 'T006A:v1:' sy-sysid ls_readback-mandt ls_readback-spras",
    "      ls_readback-msehi ls_readback-mseh3 ls_readback-mseh6",
    "      ls_readback-mseht ls_readback-msehl",
    "      INTO lv_hash_data RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_CHAR'",
    "      EXPORTING alg = lv_algorithm data = lv_hash_data",
    "      IMPORTING hashstring = lv_after_version",
    "      EXCEPTIONS unknown_alg = 1 param_error = 2 internal_error = 3",
    "        error_message = 4 OTHERS = 5.",
    "    lv_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "    IF lv_rc <> 0.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    TRANSLATE lv_after_version TO LOWER CASE.",
    "    IF lv_rc <> 0 OR strlen( lv_after_version ) <> 64",
    "    OR lv_after_version CN '0123456789abcdef'",
    "    OR lv_after_version = lv_version.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_READBACK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_commit_started = 'X'.",
    "    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'COMMIT_UNCERTAIN'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ev_code = 'APPLIED'.",
    "    ev_committed = 'X'.",
    "    ev_before_version = lv_version.",
    "    ev_text_version = lv_after_version.",
    "    ev_task = lv_task.",
    "    CONCATENATE ls_before-mandt ls_before-spras ls_before-msehi",
    "      INTO ev_tabkey RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    es_text = ls_readback.",
    "  ENDDO.",
    "CATCH cx_root.",
    "  IF lv_commit_started = 'X'.",
    "    ev_code = 'COMMIT_UNCERTAIN'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    ev_code = 'EXECUTION_FAILED'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDTRY.",
    "IF ev_code <> 'APPLIED' AND ev_code <> 'NO_CHANGES'.",
    "  CLEAR: ev_before_version, ev_text_version, ev_task, ev_tabkey,",
    "         es_text.",

    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_APPLY.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"局部接口：",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_UNIT_KEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_LANGUAGE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_EXPECTED_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_REQUEST) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_SYSTEM) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CLIENT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_USER) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_COMMITTED) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_BEFORE_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TEXT_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TABKEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGID) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGNO) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ES_TEXT) TYPE  T006A",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "\" 此 RFC 自己拥有 LUW；仅限现有 T006A 描述，不创建单位或语言行。",
    "DATA: lv_unit TYPE t006a-msehi,",
    "      lv_language TYPE t006a-spras,",
    "      lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname,",
    "      lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,",
    "      lv_request TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_task TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_policy TYPE t000-cccoractiv,",
    "      ls_parent TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_header TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_checked_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      ls_checked_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071,",
    "      lt_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071k,",
    "      lv_not_lockable TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      lv_locktype TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      ls_before TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_after TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_readback TYPE t006a,",
    "      lt_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006a,",
    "      lv_read_code TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_system TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_client TYPE string,",
    "      lv_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_after_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_unit_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_request_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_task_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_commit_started TYPE c,",
    "      lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,",
    "      lv_matches TYPE i,",
    "      lv_hash_data TYPE string,",
    "      lv_algorithm TYPE hashalg VALUE 'SHA2'.",
    "CLEAR: ev_code, ev_system, ev_client, ev_user, ev_committed,",
    "       ev_before_version,",
    "       ev_text_version, ev_task, ev_tabkey, ev_msgid, ev_msgno, es_text.",
    "ev_system = sy-sysid.",
    "ev_client = sy-mandt.",
    "ev_user = sy-uname.",
    "IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",
    "  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF strlen( iv_unit_key ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_unit_key ) > 3",
    "OR strlen( iv_language ) <> 1 OR strlen( iv_expected_version ) <> 64",
    "OR iv_expected_version CN '0123456789abcdef'",
    "OR strlen( iv_request ) <> 10 OR strlen( iv_task ) <> 10",
    "OR iv_request = iv_task.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^[A-Za-z0-9]$' IN iv_language.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_request.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_task.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit = iv_unit_key.",
    "lv_language = iv_language.",
    "lv_request = iv_request.",
    "lv_task = iv_task.",
    "IF iv_unit_key(1) = space OR strlen( lv_unit ) <> strlen( iv_unit_key )",
    "OR iv_unit_key CA '*|'.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_unit_key.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht <> space AND iv_set_mseht <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl <> space AND iv_set_msehl <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_set_msehl = space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_mseht <> space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = space AND iv_msehl <> space ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "\" 空值清除仍需独立业务验收，本版仅允许非空描述。",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_mseht ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_mseht ) > 10",
    "       OR iv_mseht CO space OR iv_mseht CP ' *' ) )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_msehl ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_msehl ) > 30",
    "       OR iv_msehl CO space OR iv_msehl CP ' *' ) ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_mseht.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_msehl.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "DO 2 TIMES.",
    "  IF sy-index = 1.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006A'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR lv_group.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat",
    "    WHERE tabname = lv_table.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.",
    "    lv_group = '&NC&'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '02' ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD lv_group.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDDO.",
    "\" E_TABLE 的初始 VARKEY 在已读生成函数中变为 *，覆盖 CUNI 的维度锁。",
    "\" 不等待；该全表锁会短暂阻止其他客户端/单位的 CUNI 维护。",
    "CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TABLE'",
    "  EXPORTING tabname = 'T006' varkey = space _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "  EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'UNIT_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "  ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit_locked = 'X'.",
    "TRY.",
    "  DO 1 TIMES.",
    "    \" 仅锁指定父请求和任务；TRINT_LOCK_REQUEST 自带 COMMIT，不能复用。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_request _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_request_locked = 'X'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_task _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_task_locked = 'X'.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE cccoractiv INTO lv_policy FROM t000 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_policy NA '01'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CLIENT_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" ALE_EDIT_CHECK_2 含无条件 MESSAGE I；有 CUNI 分布式规则就拒绝。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd72 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE objekttyp = 'T' AND objektname = 'CUNI'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 标准模型读取会缓存/过滤规则；本版拒绝所有 CONDAT 记录，保守限缩范围。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd05 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mestyp = 'CONDAT'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_parent-trkorr = lv_request.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_parent",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_parent-trfunction <> 'W'",
    "    OR ls_parent-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_parent-strkorr <> space",
    "    OR ls_parent-client <> sy-mandt OR ls_parent-tarsystem = space.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_header-trkorr = lv_task.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_header",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_header-trfunction <> 'Q'",
    "    OR ls_header-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_header-strkorr <> lv_request",
    "    OR ls_header-as4user <> sy-uname OR ls_header-client <> sy-mandt.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 锁内调用同一个只读 API，版本包含键、别名和两个描述的完整行。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_READ'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_unit_key = iv_unit_key iv_language = iv_language",
    "      IMPORTING ev_code = lv_read_code ev_system = lv_read_system",
    "        ev_client = lv_read_client ev_text_version = lv_version",
    "        es_text = ls_before",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_read_code <> 'READ'",
    "    OR lv_read_system <> 'GR2' OR lv_read_client <> '200'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'READ_PRECONDITION_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF lv_version <> iv_expected_version.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 表缓冲读不作为锁内新鲜度证据，必须与数据库完整行一致。",
    "    SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_readback",
    "      FROM t006a BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_readback <> ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_after = ls_before.",
    "    IF iv_set_mseht = 'X'. ls_after-mseht = iv_mseht. ENDIF.",
    "    IF iv_set_msehl = 'X'. ls_after-msehl = iv_msehl. ENDIF.",
    "    IF ls_after = ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'NO_CHANGES'.",
    "      ev_before_version = lv_version.",
    "      ev_text_version = lv_version.",
    "      es_text = ls_before.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_object-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_object-object = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_object-obj_name = 'CUNI'.",
    "    ls_object-objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_OBJECT'",
    "      EXPORTING is_object = ls_object is_request_header = ls_header",
    "        iv_check_lockability = 'X' iv_dialog = space",
    "        iv_release_checks = space",
    "      IMPORTING es_object = ls_checked_object",
    "        ev_object_not_lockable = lv_not_lockable",
    "        ev_locktype = lv_locktype",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_OBJECT_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 拒绝需要版本管理/TLOCK/修复分支的对象，保持本版单一 DB LUW。",
    "    IF lv_not_lockable <> 'X' OR lv_locktype <> space",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-pgmid <> 'R3TR'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-object <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-obj_name <> 'CUNI'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-objfunc <> 'K'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCKABLE_OBJECT_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_key-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_key-object = 'TABU'.",
    "    ls_key-objname = 'T006A'.",
    "    ls_key-mastertype = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_key-mastername = 'CUNI'.",
    "    CONCATENATE ls_before-mandt ls_before-spras ls_before-msehi",
    "      INTO ls_key-tabkey RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_KEY'",
    "      EXPORTING is_key = ls_key is_request_header = ls_header",
    "      IMPORTING es_key = ls_checked_key",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_checked_key-tabkey <> ls_key-tabkey",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-pgmid <> 'R3TR' OR ls_checked_key-object <> 'TABU'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-objname <> 'T006A'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastertype <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastername <> 'CUNI'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_KEY_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    APPEND ls_object TO lt_objects.",
    "    APPEND ls_key TO lt_keys.",
    "    \" 继续运行标准所有权/对象/语言键校验，所有跳过检查标志均保持默认。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_APPEND_TO_COMM_ARRAYS'",
    "      EXPORTING wi_trkorr = lv_task iv_dialog = space",
    "      TABLES wt_e071 = lt_objects wt_e071k = lt_keys",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_APPEND_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND obj_name = 'CUNI' AND objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071k",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TABU'",
    "        AND objname = 'T006A' AND mastertype = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND mastername = 'CUNI'",
    "        AND tabkey = ls_key-tabkey.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 同步调用标准 UPDATE_T006A，避免 CTS 先提交而 V1 更新后失败。",
    "    APPEND ls_after TO lt_text.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'UPDATE_T006A'",
    "      TABLES t006a_tab = lt_text",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_UPDATE_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",

    "************************************************************************",
    "***call version management when appending to tasks and K-Requests*******",
    "***when locktype is",
    "***                space  : not locked",
    "***                    R  : correct order/task, but wrong size",
    "***                    P  : shared locks, different tasks same order",
    "************************************************************************",
    "        IF lv_locktype CA ' RP'",

    "             OR ls_e070-trfunction = trco ).",
    "          ls_e071 = wt_e071.",

    "            TABLES",
    "              e071_tab = lt_e071",
    "            EXCEPTIONS",
    "              OTHERS   = 0.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** insert/update lock-entry if object is lockable *********************",
    "*** create pattern for TLOCK-LIKE-deletion *  **************************",
    "        IF lv_locktype NA ' XL'.",
    "          lv_hikey_pattern = ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "          IF ls_lockkey-pat_len > 0.",
    "            ASSIGN lv_hikey_pattern(ls_lockkey-pat_len)",
    "                                    TO <lv_firstpart>.",
    "*           work around LIKE OR LIKE",
    "            lv_length_firstpart = STRLEN( <lv_firstpart> ).",
    "            IF lv_length_firstpart > ls_lockkey-pat_len.",
    "              lv_length_firstpart = ls_lockkey-pat_len.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            lv_rest_length = lv_hikeylen - lv_length_firstpart.",
    "            IF lv_rest_length > 0.",
    "            ASSIGN lv_hikey_pattern+lv_length_firstpart(lv_rest_length)",
    "                     TO <lv_remainder>.",
    "              <lv_remainder> = '%'.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            lv_hikey_pattern = '%'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "        CASE lv_locktype.",
    "*** no append, if order already locked by owner right size *************",
    "          WHEN 'L'.",
    "",
    "*** object is not locked  **********************************************",
    "          WHEN space.",
    "            wt_e071-lockflag = 'X'.",
    "            ls_tlock-object      = ls_lockkey-obj.",
    "            ls_tlock-hikey       = ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "            ls_tlock-lokey       = ls_lockkey-low.",
    "            ls_tlock-len         = ls_lockkey-len.",
    "            ls_tlock-trkorr      = ls_e070-trkorr.",
    "            ls_tlock-author      = sy-uname.",
    "            ls_tlock-edtflag     = lv_edit.",
    "            INSERT tlock FROM ls_tlock.",
    "",
    "            IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "              PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.",
    "              IF lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "                ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object",
    "                                    ls_tlock-hikey(50)",
    "                               RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "",
    "*** object is locked for this order in different size ******************",
    "          WHEN 'R'.",
    "            wt_e071-lockflag = 'X'.",
    "*           leave if any order-lock is already bigger",
    "            IF ls_tlock-hikey <= ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "*             delete smaller locks and set bigger one",
    "              DELETE FROM tlock",
    "                     WHERE object =    ls_lockkey-obj",
    "                     AND   hikey  >=   ls_lockkey-low",
    "                     AND   hikey  LIKE lv_hikey_pattern",
    "                     AND   lokey  <=   ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "              IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.",
    "                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "                  ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "                ENDIF.",
    "                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object",
    "                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)",
    "                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "              ls_tlock-object      = ls_lockkey-obj.",
    "              ls_tlock-hikey       = ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "              ls_tlock-lokey       = ls_lockkey-low.",
    "              ls_tlock-len         = ls_lockkey-len.",
    "              ls_tlock-trkorr      = ls_e070-trkorr.",
    "              ls_tlock-author      = sy-uname.",
    "              ls_tlock-edtflag     = lv_edit.",
    "              INSERT tlock FROM ls_tlock.",
    "              IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.",
    "                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "                  ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "                ENDIF.",
    "                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object",
    "                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)",
    "                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              lv_locktype = k_l.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** object locks are shared in request *********************************",
    "          WHEN 'P'.",
    "            lv_shared        = 'X'.",
    "            wt_e071-lockflag = 'X'.",
    "*           if request locks are smaller, delete them and set bigger one",
    "            IF ls_tlock-hikey <= ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "              DELETE FROM tlock",
    "                     WHERE object =    ls_lockkey-obj",
    "                     AND   hikey  >=   ls_lockkey-low",
    "                     AND   hikey  LIKE lv_hikey_pattern",
    "                     AND   lokey  <=   ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "              IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.",
    "                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "                  ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "                ENDIF.",
    "                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object",
    "                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)",
    "                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "              ls_tlock-object      = ls_lockkey-obj.",
    "              ls_tlock-hikey       = ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "              ls_tlock-lokey       = ls_lockkey-low.",
    "              ls_tlock-len         = ls_lockkey-len.",
    "              ls_tlock-trkorr      = ls_e070-trkorr.",
    "              ls_tlock-author      = sy-uname.",
    "              ls_tlock-edtflag     = lv_edit.",
    "              INSERT tlock FROM ls_tlock.",
    "              IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.",
    "                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "                  ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "                ENDIF.",
    "                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object",
    "                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)",
    "                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "*** if projects locks are bigger, switch lock to this order ************",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              IF ls_tlock-hikey <> ls_lockkey-hi.",
    "                CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REVERSE_KEY'",
    "                  EXPORTING",
    "                    wi_tlock       = ls_tlock",
    "                  IMPORTING",
    "                    we_object      = wt_e071-object",
    "                    we_obj_name    = wt_e071-obj_name",
    "                    we_pgmid       = wt_e071-pgmid",
    "                  EXCEPTIONS",
    "                    unknown_object = 1.",
    "                IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "                  PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.",
    "                  IF lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "                    ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "                  ENDIF.",
    "                  current_message_raising tr_lockmod_failed.",
    "                ENDIF.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              ls_tlock-trkorr  = ls_e070-trkorr.",
    "              ls_tlock-author  = sy-uname.",
    "              ls_tlock-edtflag = lv_edit.",
    "              UPDATE tlock FROM ls_tlock.",
    "              IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "                PERFORM dequeue_all USING lv_enqueue_done lt_enqueue.",
    "                IF lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "                  ROLLBACK WORK.",
    "                ENDIF.",
    "                MESSAGE e125(tk) WITH ls_tlock-object",
    "                                      ls_tlock-hikey(50)",
    "                                 RAISING tr_lockmod_failed.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              lv_update_done = 'X'.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "        ENDCASE.",
    "",

    "        PERFORM set_cico_comnt USING ls_lockkey",

    "*** no append, if order already locked by owner right size *************",

    "      IF lv_locktype = k_l.",
    "        IF ( wt_e071-pgmid          = 'R3TR'",

  "source": [
    "FUNCTION tr_req_check_key.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IS_KEY) TYPE  E071K",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IS_REQUEST_HEADER) TYPE  TRWBO_REQUEST_HEADER",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IV_COLLECT_MODE) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ES_KEY) TYPE  E071K",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CT_MESSAGES) TYPE  CTSGERRMSGS OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      INVALID_SYNTAX",
    "*\"      INVALID_TABLE",
    "*\"      INVALID_KEY",
    "*\"      WRONG_CALL",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA:",
    "******* Properties of the string in E071K-TABKEY",
    "*       Length of key specification with generic '*'",
    "        lv_len_filled_key            TYPE sy-fdpos,",
    "",
    "*       Length of key specification without generic '*'",
    "        lv_len_full_spec             TYPE i,",
    "",
    "*       Use and position of generic symbol",
    "        lv_generic_used              TYPE trboolean,",
    "        lv_start_generic             TYPE i,",
    "",
    "******* Table properties",
    "        ls_table_header              TYPE x030l,",
    "        lt_table_dfies               TYPE TABLE OF dfies,",
    "        lv_no_of_keyfields           TYPE i,",
    "        lv_non_char_key_fields_exist TYPE trboolean,",
    "",
    "*       Length of concatenated char key fields up to first nonchar field",
    "        lv_char_key_length           TYPE dntab-intlen,",
    "",
    "******* Temporary variables",
    "        lv_cursor_pos                TYPE ctsgerrmsg-cursor_pos,",
    "        lv_i                         TYPE i,",
    "        ls_dfies                     TYPE dfies,",
    "        lv_end_of_field              TYPE i,",
    "        lv_length_part_first         TYPE i,",
    "        lv_allowed_key_length        TYPE i,",
    "        lv_pos_for_star              TYPE i,",
    "        lv_mess_var                  LIKE sy-msgv1,",
    "* used in CHECK_CUSTOMER_NAMES to protect customer entries in",
    "* class E and G tables",
    "        lv_key_allowed               TYPE trpari-keyallowed,",
    "        lv_key_mixed                 TYPE trpari-keyallowed.",
    "",
    "  STATICS: sv_table_name             TYPE ddobjname,",
    "           sv_delivery_class         TYPE dd02l-contflag,",
    "           sv_last_key               TYPE e071k,",
    "           st_allowed_languages      TYPE TABLE OF t002-spras,",
    "           sv_systemtype             TYPE sy-sysid,",
    "           sv_system_client_edit     TYPE t000-cccoractiv.",
    "",
    "",
    "  CONSTANTS:     lc_max_keylength    TYPE dntab-intlen VALUE 120.",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_key_field>      TYPE c,",
    "                 <lv_key_part_first> TYPE c.",
    "  cts_error_data.",
    "",
    "* Check input parameters------------------------------------------------",
    "  IF is_request_header-trkorr     = space",
    "  OR is_request_header-trfunction = space",
    "  OR is_request_header-as4user    = space",
    "  OR is_request_header-client     = space.",
    "    set_error_key cterr_key space is_key-as4pos",
    "                  is_key-pgmid is_key-object is_key-objname.",
    "*   Interner Fehler beim Aufruf einer Schnittstelle des CTS",
    "    cts_error_message4 'E' 'TK' '514'",
    "                       'TR_REQ_CHECK_KEY'",
    "                       is_request_header-trkorr",
    "                       is_request_header-trfunction",
    "                       is_request_header-client",
    "                       wrong_call.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Initialize static fields",
    "  IF sv_systemtype IS INITIAL.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_SYS_PARAMS'",
    "         IMPORTING",
    "              systemtype         = sv_systemtype",
    "              system_client_edit = sv_system_client_edit",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              OTHERS             = 0.",
    "",
    "    SELECT spras FROM t002",
    "                 INTO TABLE st_allowed_languages",
    "                 ORDER BY PRIMARY KEY.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Check syntax ---------------------------------------------------------",
    "  set_error_key cterr_key space",
    "                is_key-as4pos is_key-pgmid is_key-object is_key-objname.",
    "",
    "* Invalid pgmid, object or objname?",
    "  IF (    is_key-pgmid <> 'R3TR'",
    "      AND is_key-pgmid <> 'LANG' )",
    "  OR is_key-object  <> 'TABU'",
    "  OR is_key-objname =  space.",
    "    cts_error_message3 'E' 'TR' '586'",
    "                       is_key-pgmid",
    "                       is_key-object",
    "                       is_key-objname",
    "                       invalid_syntax.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Masterfields have to be filled",
    "  IF is_key-mastertype = space",
    "  OR is_key-mastername = space.",
    "*   Bezugsfelder eines Objektschlüssels nicht gefüllt (intern. Synta...)",
    "    cts_error_message0 'E' 'TR' '590'",
    "                       invalid_syntax.",
    "  ELSEIF ( is_key-mastertype <> 'TABU'",
    "      AND  is_key-mastertype <> 'CDAT'",
    "      AND  is_key-mastertype <> 'TDAT'",
    "      AND  is_key-mastertype <> 'VDAT' ).",
    "*   invalid value for MASTERTYPE",
    "    cts_error_message1 'E' 'TR' '584'",
    "                       is_key-mastertype",
    "                       invalid_syntax.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* TABKEY has to be filled",
    "  IF is_key-tabkey = space.",
    "*   Bei Transport von Tabelleninhalten muß Schlüssel gefüllt sein",
    "    cts_error_message1 'E' 'TR' '587'",
    "                       is_key-objname",
    "                       invalid_syntax.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* OBJFUNC must not be filled",
    "  IF is_key-objfunc <> space.",
    "*   Schlüsseleintrag ist mit angegebener Funktion nicht möglich",
    "    cts_error_message0 'E' 'TR' '588'",
    "                       invalid_syntax.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Check the table ------------------------------------------------------",
    "  set_error_key cterr_key 'OBJNAME'",
    "                is_key-as4pos is_key-pgmid is_key-object is_key-objname.",
    "",
    "* Read information about table",
    "  IF sv_table_name <> is_key-objname.",
    "    sv_table_name = is_key-objname.",
    "",
    "    SELECT contflag",
    "           FROM  dd02l",
    "           INTO  sv_delivery_class",
    "           WHERE tabname  = is_key-objname",
    "           AND   as4local = 'A'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDSELECT.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      CLEAR sv_delivery_class.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_NAMETAB_GET'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            iv_tabname = sv_table_name",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            et_dfies   = lt_table_dfies",
    "            es_header  = ls_table_header",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            not_found  = 1.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    cts_error_message4 'E' sy-msgid sy-msgno",
    "                       sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                       invalid_table.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  IF ls_table_header-tabtype = 'J'.    \" is this enough?",
    "*   Objekt &1 ist keine Datenbanktabelle",
    "    cts_error_message1 'E' 'TK' '316'",
    "                       sv_table_name",
    "                       invalid_table.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  IF  sv_systemtype     = 'SAP'",
    "  AND sv_delivery_class = 'W'.",
    "*   Tabelle & hat Auslieferungsklasse \"W\" (Systemtabelle)",
    "    cts_error_message1 'W' 'TK' '552'",
    "                       is_key-objname",
    "                       invalid_key.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Check if table belongs to TDAT/VDAT/CDAT",
    "  IF  (   is_key-mastertype  = 'TDAT'",
    "       OR is_key-mastertype  = 'CDAT'",
    "       OR is_key-mastertype  = 'VDAT'",
    "       OR is_key-mastertype  = 'TABU' )\"isn't this always true?",
    "  AND (   sv_last_key-object <> is_key-object",
    "       OR sv_last_key-objname <> is_key-objname",
    "       OR sv_last_key-viewname <> is_key-viewname",
    "       OR sv_last_key-mastertype  <> is_key-mastertype",
    "       OR sv_last_key-mastername  <> is_key-mastername ).",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'CTO_E071K_CHECK_OBJECT_TABLE'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              is_e071k        = is_key",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              no_object_table = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      cts_error_message4 'E' sy-msgid sy-msgno",
    "                         sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                         invalid_table.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      sv_last_key = is_key.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "",
    "* Check tabkey ---------------------------------------------------------",
    "  set_error_key cterr_key 'TABKEY'",
    "                is_key-as4pos is_key-pgmid is_key-object is_key-objname.",
    "",
    "",
    "* Get key length by finding the beginning of the trailing spaces",
    "  IF is_key-tabkey CP '*# '.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  lv_len_filled_key = sy-fdpos.",
    "",
    "* Check use of generic sign '*'",
    "  IF is_key-tabkey CP '*#*# '.   \"pos. of last * followed by spaces only",
    "    lv_generic_used  = 'X'.",
    "    lv_start_generic = sy-fdpos + 1.",
    "    lv_len_full_spec = lv_len_filled_key - 1.",
    "",
    "  ELSEIF is_key-tabkey+119(1) EQ '*'.",
    "    lv_generic_used  = 'X'.",
    "    lv_start_generic = 120.",
    "    lv_len_full_spec = 119.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  LOOP AT lt_table_dfies INTO ls_dfies",
    "                         WHERE keyflag = 'X'.",
    "",
    "*   Client part in tabkey-string has to be a) = source client of request",
    "*                                       or b) fully generic",
    "*                                       or c) = space",
    "    IF  sy-tabix          = 1",
    "    AND ls_dfies-datatype = 'CLNT'.",
    "      IF  is_request_header-client <> is_key-tabkey(3) \"a)",
    "      AND is_key-tabkey(3)         <> '*  '            \"b)",
    "      AND is_request_header-client <> space.           \"c)  \"???",
    "*       Auftrag/Aufgabe &1 (&2) hat andere Mandantenzuordnung",
    "        cts_error_message4 'E' 'TK' '420'",
    "                           is_request_header-trkorr",
    "                           is_request_header-as4user",
    "                           is_request_header-client",
    "                           is_key-tabkey(3)",
    "                           invalid_key.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      IF  sv_system_client_edit = '3'",
    "      AND is_request_header-tarsystem <> space.",
    "*       Stuff is client dependent, but transport of client dependent",
    "*       stuff is forbidden: error",
    "        cts_error_message3 'E' 'TR' '080'",
    "                           es_key-pgmid",
    "                           es_key-mastertype",
    "                           es_key-mastername",
    "                           invalid_table.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    ADD 1 TO lv_no_of_keyfields.",
    "",
    "*   Determine total length of char-like key-fields. + 1 for final '*'",
    "*  12.03:only charachter type 'CNDT' allowed  .",
    "*   raw data type'X'.( zwei zeichen = 1 byte). arrowed ?  dann soll.",
    "*   IF  ls_dfies-inttype NA 'CDNSTX'",
    "",
    "    IF  ls_dfies-inttype NA 'CDNST'",
    "    AND lv_non_char_key_fields_exist = space.",
    "      lv_non_char_key_fields_exist = 'X'.",
    "      ADD 1 TO lv_char_key_length.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    IF lv_non_char_key_fields_exist = ' '.",
    "      ADD ls_dfies-intlen TO lv_char_key_length.",
    "*& 12.03 :if  raw data type'X', char lenth =",
    "*&  ADD ls_dfies-intlen * 2 TO lv_char_key_length.",
    "      IF ls_dfies-offset < lc_max_keylength.",
    "*       Get the value of the key field",
    "        IF lv_char_key_length <= lc_max_keylength.",
    "          lv_i = ls_dfies-intlen.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          lv_i = lc_max_keylength - ls_dfies-offset.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ASSIGN is_key-tabkey+ls_dfies-offset(lv_i)",
    "               TO <lv_key_field>.",
    "",
    "*       Apply correct uppercase conversion",
    "        IF  es_key IS REQUESTED",
    "        AND ls_dfies-lowercase <> 'X'.",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_TRANSLATE_TO_UPPER'",
    "               CHANGING",
    "                    cv_string = <lv_key_field>.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*       Correct syntax for generic entries?",
    "        lv_end_of_field = ls_dfies-offset + ls_dfies-intlen.",
    "        IF  lv_generic_used  =  'X'",
    "        AND <lv_key_field>   CA '%_'",
    "        AND lv_start_generic <= lv_end_of_field.",
    "*         Error: special sign in the field with the generic key",
    "          lv_cursor_pos = sy-fdpos + ls_dfies-offset.",
    "*         Sonderzeichen \"&\" in generischem Schlüssel",
    "          cts_error_message_pos3 'E' 'TK' '287'",
    "                                 is_key-tabkey+lv_cursor_pos(1)",
    "                                 is_key-objname",
    "                                 is_key-tabkey",
    "                                 lv_cursor_pos",
    "                                 invalid_key.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*       Check compatibility between value and field type",
    "        IF ls_dfies-datatype = 'ACCP'",
    "        OR ls_dfies-datatype = 'DATS'",
    "        OR ls_dfies-datatype = 'NUMC'",
    "        OR ls_dfies-datatype = 'TIMS'",
    "        OR ls_dfies-datatype = 'TMST'.",
    "          IF lv_generic_used  = space",
    "          OR lv_start_generic > lv_end_of_field.",
    "            IF <lv_key_field> CN '0123456789'.",
    "*             Key field of a full qualified key has wrong data type",
    "              PERFORM send_error_wrong_data USING <lv_key_field>",
    "                                                  ls_dfies-intlen",
    "                                                  ls_dfies-fieldname",
    "                                                  ls_dfies-datatype",
    "                                                  iv_collect_mode",
    "                                            CHANGING",
    "                                                  lv_e_index",
    "                                                  ls_errormessage",
    "                                                  ct_messages.",
    "",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            lv_length_part_first = lv_len_full_spec - ls_dfies-offset.",
    "            IF lv_length_part_first > 0.",
    "              ASSIGN is_key-tabkey+ls_dfies-offset(lv_length_part_first)",
    "                       TO <lv_key_part_first>.",
    "              IF <lv_key_part_first> CN '0123456789'.",
    "*               Key field, of a generic key, has wrong data type",
    "                PERFORM send_error_wrong_data USING <lv_key_field>",
    "                                                    ls_dfies-intlen",
    "                                                    ls_dfies-fieldname",
    "                                                    ls_dfies-datatype",
    "                                                    iv_collect_mode",
    "                                              CHANGING",
    "                                                    lv_e_index",
    "                                                    ls_errormessage",
    "                                                    ct_messages.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*       Check fields of type LANG",
    "        IF ls_dfies-datatype = 'LANG'.",
    "          PERFORM check_orig_lang_of_key USING    is_key",
    "                                                  <lv_key_field>",
    "                                                  is_request_header",
    "                                                  iv_collect_mode",
    "                                         CHANGING lv_e_index",
    "                                                  ls_errormessage",
    "                                                  ct_messages.",
    "",
    "          lv_end_of_field = ls_dfies-offset + 1.",
    "          IF  <lv_key_field>       <> sy-langu",
    "          AND <lv_key_field>       <> '*'",
    "          AND (   lv_generic_used  =  space",
    "               OR lv_start_generic >  lv_end_of_field ).",
    "            READ TABLE st_allowed_languages",
    "                       TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS",
    "                       WITH KEY table_line = <lv_key_field>",
    "                       BINARY SEARCH.",
    "            IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "*           Error: specified language is not allowed (not in table T002)",

    "                                                   ls_dfies-intlen",
    "                                          CHANGING lv_mess_var.",
    "*             & ist keine gültige Sprache",
    "              cts_error_message_pos4 'E' 'TK' '295'",
    "                                     lv_mess_var",
    "                                     is_key-objname",
    "                                     sy-langu",
    "                                     ls_dfies-fieldname",
    "                                     ls_dfies-offset",
    "                                     invalid_key.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*       Point to asterisks that are not interpreted as generic sign",
    "        IF  <lv_key_field>    CS '*'",
    "        AND ls_dfies-datatype <> 'LANG'.",
    "          lv_cursor_pos = sy-fdpos + ls_dfies-offset.",
    "          IF lv_len_full_spec > lv_cursor_pos.",
    "*           Nur der Stern am Ende bewirkt Generik",
    "            cts_error_message_pos1 'W' 'TK' '296'",
    "                                   is_key-tabkey(lv_len_full_spec)",
    "                                   lv_cursor_pos",
    "                                   invalid_key.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "* no keyfields",
    "  IF lv_no_of_keyfields = 0.",
    "*   Für Tabelle &1 sind keine Schlüsselfelder definiert",
    "    cts_error_message1 'E' 'TK' '318'",
    "                       is_key-objname",
    "                       invalid_table.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* given key longer than character-key-part",
    "  IF lv_len_filled_key > lv_char_key_length.",

    "    cts_error_message2 'E' 'TK' '319'",
    "                       is_key-objname",
    "                       lv_char_key_length+3 \"+3 wg Ausgabe NUMC-6 !?!?",
    "                       invalid_key.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",

    "  IF lv_char_key_length >= lc_max_keylength.",
    "    lv_allowed_key_length = lc_max_keylength.",
